title: Implement Filtered WebSocket Subscriptions
description: Extend the WebSocket streaming from FORGEOS-BE039 to support client-side filter subscriptions. Clients can subscribe to filtered streams (by stage, type, agent, or ticket_id) to receive only relevant events. Implement subscription management: clients send subscribe/unsubscribe messages to control their filter set.
acceptance_criteria: Clients can send subscribe messages with filter criteria (stage, type, agent_id, ticket_id)
Clients can send unsubscribe messages to remove filters
Filtered clients receive only events matching their subscription criteria
Multiple simultaneous filters are combined with OR logic (any match passes)
Default behavior (no subscription) receives all events
Backpressure management drops oldest events for slow consumers after buffer limit
